svg.title: When the game goes through the triggers
svg.desc: Three frame rulers from StarCraft 1.16.1. Ordinary triggers are gone through on frames 2, 33 and 64, every 31 frames. With hyper triggers, every 2 frames. A Wait of 1000 milliseconds started on frame 2 at Fastest runs out on frame 26, so the next pass is on frame 27, and the 31-frame cycle goes on from there. Inside a pass, Players 1 to 8 in order, each player's triggers top to bottom.
svg.text: When the game goes through the triggers
a pass every 31 frames, the first on frame 2
a pass every 2 frames, never every frame
runs out on 26, so the next pass is 27
conditions asked in order; the first false one stops them
all true: the actions run in order, until one has to wait
part way through its actions: carries on, conditions not asked
Players in the game, 1 to 8 in order; each player's triggers top to bottom, as the list has them. A pass comes
after the frame's units have moved and fought. A Wait running out, or the countdown reaching 0, brings the next
pass forward to the following frame for every player. Game speed changes how long a Wait lasts, nothing else.
